primary_source.title: Unified RAW Image Exposure Correction and Restoration via Linear Illumination and Frequency-Adaptive Enhancement
primary_source.summary: RIECR separates exposure estimation from residual restoration and gates low/high convolution responses. Its CMER benchmark uses223 static Canon scenes;metrics primarily score packed RAW exposure restoration. Component ablations support the full system on that benchmark. The paper acknowledges ambiguity in fully clipped highlights. These results do not establish joint RGB demosaicing quality or noisy-flat safety on our GFX scenes.

own_fixtures.geometry: 8x8 circular scalar grid;no borders,resizing,color model or learned weights
own_fixtures.gate: one on first4 columns,zero on remaining4

inference: Even an exact zero-DC high-pass response can retain/amplify noisy-flat variance. Multiplication by spatial support can introduce DC after filtering. Preserving whole-image mean does not preserve every local quiet region. These own counterexamples reject a flat-safety inference;they do not reject the paper or measure any trained model. Our current spectral proposal is spatially gated after its band restriction,so the analogous property must be assessed on delivered RGB. No next architecture is selected before V165 quality.

"""Primary-source reading plus independent counterexamples to a flat-safety inference."""
from pathlib import Path
import urllib.request
import numpy as np
from train_directional_bank_trial import ref,save
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');cache=repo/'.cache/research-20261107/arxiv-2610.28191v1.html'
url='https://arxiv.org/html/2610.28191v1'
if not cache.exists():
 response=urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=20)
 with cache.open('xb') as f:f.write(response.read())
body=cache.read_text();assert 'Frequency Dynamic Convolution' in body and '2610.28191' in body
# Own numeric fixture,not paper kernels,weights,noise synthesis or trained outputs.
size=8;kernel=-np.ones((3,3),dtype=np.float64)/8;kernel[1,1]=1
assert kernel.sum()==0 and np.sum(kernel**2)==9/8
matrix=np.zeros((size*size,size*size),dtype=np.float64)
for y in range(size):
 for x in range(size):
  for dy in range(-1,2):
   for dx in range(-1,2):matrix[y*size+x,((y+dy)%size)*size+(x+dx)%size]+=kernel[dy+1,dx+1]
ones=np.ones(size*size);assert np.array_equal(matrix@ones,np.zeros_like(ones))
# Identity covariance gives exact variance amplification without random sampling.
variance=np.diag(matrix@matrix.T);assert np.array_equal(variance,np.full(size*size,9/8))
x=np.arange(size);signal=np.broadcast_to(np.cos(2*np.pi*x/size)[None],(size,size)).copy()
high=(matrix@signal.ravel()).reshape(size,size)
gate=np.zeros_like(high);gate[:,:size//2]=1
mean_before=float(high.mean());mean_after=float((high*gate).mean())
assert abs(mean_before)<1e-16 and mean_after>0.02
expected=(.75*(1-np.cos(2*np.pi/size)))/8
assert abs(mean_after-expected)<1e-16
# A zero whole-image mean also permits a nonzero local quiet-region shift.
correction=np.ones((size,size));correction[:,size//2:]=-1
assert correction.mean()==0 and correction[:,:size//2].mean()==1
out=repo/'docs/results/frequency-gating-reading-20261107-v1.json';assert not out.exists()
save(out,{'status':'completed-primary-source-reading-and-independent-numerical-fixtures',
 'primary_source':{'title':'Unified RAW Image Exposure Correction and Restoration via Linear Illumination and Frequency-Adaptive Enhancement',

  'summary':'RIECR separates exposure estimation from residual restoration and gates low/high convolution responses. Its CMER benchmark uses223 static Canon scenes;metrics primarily score packed RAW exposure restoration. Component ablations support the full system on that benchmark. The paper acknowledges ambiguity in fully clipped highlights. These results do not establish joint RGB demosaicing quality or noisy-flat safety on our GFX scenes.'},
 'own_fixtures':{'not_a_paper_implementation':True,'geometry':'8x8 circular scalar grid;no borders,resizing,color model or learned weights',
  'kernel':kernel.tolist(),'exact_kernel_DC':0,'exact_constant_output_max':0,
  'white_identity_covariance_output_variance':float(variance[0]),'input_variance':1,'noise_variance_multiplier':9/8,
  'gate':'one on first4 columns,zero on remaining4','period8_signal_output_mean_before_gate':mean_before,
  'period8_signal_output_mean_after_gate':mean_after,'independent_expected_gated_mean':float(expected),
  'global_mean_conserved_example':{'whole_mean':0,'left_half_mean':1,'right_half_mean':-1}},
